response.justification: Bogdan is a highly accomplished engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, plus a CS degree and strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing). However, this is an entry-level Java role, and the profile is severely overqualified, which creates real risk around compensation expectations, motivation and retention. More decisively, the posting requires strong verbal and written German for client-facing insurance projects, and the resume lists German as basic only. Java also appears only peripherally (robotic arms and a device orchestration tool circa 2016-2018), with the recent decade centered on TypeScript/Node, DLang and cloud tooling. A senior or staff-level polyglot backend opening would be a far better match than this junior req.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience with strong agile/TDD craftsmanship
CS degree plus proven cloud, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD exposure
Berlin-based, with teaching, workshops and open-source leadership
concerns: Only basic German versus required client-facing German fluency
Massively overqualified for an entry-level individual contributor role
Java is a minor, dated part of a mostly TypeScript/DLang career

key_factors.factor: Overall engineering depth and agile practice
